new = '''def materialize(seq, lo, hi):
    """Return the literal bytes of ``seq[lo:hi]`` (bounded windows only)."""
    if lo >= hi:
        return b''
    if hi - lo > MATERIALIZE_LIMIT:
        raise ValueError('bounded materialization')
    parts = []
    stack = [('r', seq, lo, hi)]
    while stack:
        item = stack.pop()
        kind = item[0]
        if kind == 'M':
            mark, count = item[1], item[2]
            chunk = b''.join(parts[mark:])
            del parts[mark:]
            parts.append(chunk * count)
            continue
        if kind == 's':
            node = item[1]
            if node.tag == 'L':
                parts.append(node.a)
            elif node.tag == 'C':
                stack.append(('s', node.b))
                stack.append(('s', node.a))
            else:
                base, count = node.a, node.b
                if base.tag == 'L':
                    parts.append(base.a * count)
                else:
                    stack.append(('M', len(parts), count))
                    stack.append(('s', base))
            continue
        node, low, high = item[1], item[2], item[3]
        if low >= high:
            continue
        if low == 0 and high == node.n:
            stack.append(('s', node))
            continue
        if node.tag == 'L':
            parts.append(node.a[low:high])
            continue
        stack.extend(reversed(list(_split(node, low, high))))
    return b''.join(parts)
